name: SoftGlaze Maintenance Mode & Coming Soon
author: softglaze

sections.description:
SoftGlaze Maintenance Mode & Coming Soon is the ultimate solution for managing your site’s downtime or pre-launch phase. Version 1.4.1 improves custom page rendering (Gutenberg/Elementor), fixes maintenance layout/background handling, and adds clearer integration fields for GA4/GTM/verifications.

New in v1.4.2:
* 10 Vibrant Templates: Added 2 brand‑new Maintenance layouts (more modern + more flexible).
* Builder-Compatible Landing Pages: SoftGlaze Landing Pages can now be edited with Elementor and other popular page builders.
* Smarter Presets: Preset picker now shows Coming Soon vs Maintenance presets based on your active mode, with a preview (headline + message) before applying.
* Countdown Finish Actions: Set a custom “finished” message and/or redirect URL when the timer ends.
* Cleaner UI: Improved styling for Access Control selectors and the front-end password access modal.
* Brand Social Colors: Social icons now use official platform colors for better recognition.

Key Features:

  • 3 Modes: Live (Off), Coming Soon (HTTP 200 – indexed by Google), and Maintenance Mode (HTTP 503 – tells search engines to come back later).
  • Visual Form Builder: Capture leads with custom fields (Text, Email, Phone). Data is saved locally and can be exported to CSV.
  • Design Inheritance: “Inherit Theme” option lets you use your site’s native fonts and colors for seamless branding.
  • Integrations: Add GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, site verification tags, and optional advanced code snippets easily.
  • Access Control: Whitelist User Roles, Specific Users, IP Addresses (CIDR supported), or use a “Secret Bypass Link”.
  • Social Media Icons: Support for 10+ platforms including WhatsApp, TikTok, Telegram, and X (Twitter) with SVG icons.
  • GDPR Ready: Includes consent notices and data export tools.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the softglaze-maintenance-mode-coming-soon folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to SoftGlaze Coming Soon to configure your settings.
  4. Use the top Status Bar to enable “Coming Soon” or “Maintenance” mode.
sections.faq:
What is the difference between Coming Soon (200) and Maintenance (503)?

  • Coming Soon (200): Tells Google “This site is new, please index this page.” Use this for new launches.
  • Maintenance (503): Tells Google “The site is temporarily down, check back later.” Use this for updates to protect your SEO ranking.

Can I use Gravity Forms or Contact Form 7?

Yes! In the Subscriber Form settings, switch the “Form Type” to Shortcode and paste your form shortcode there.

How do the Content Presets work?

In the Design tab, look for the “Load a Preset” dropdown. Selecting an option (like “Under Construction” or “We’re Launching Soon”) will automatically fill in a professional Headline and Message for you.

Can I allow a specific client to see the site?

Yes. You can either:
1. Add their specific User Account to the “Whitelisted Users” list in the Access tab.
2. Generate a Secret Bypass Link and send it to them. They can view the site without logging in.

  • Fixed: Theme Font/Color inheritance logic.

  • Added Admin Status Bar.

  • Initial release.
